admission.justification: Prevents a bounded copy refresh from silently shedding a file it can no longer restore.

applicability: Admitted leaf task-copy admission, reconciliation and status scans.
conditions: Per-file and cumulative rollback budgets cover every admitted written copy before first publication.
Index/scan/status populations have explicit budgets and honest refusal or bounded projection.
exclusions: No silent skipping of an admitted original, unbounded copy corpus or Git transaction authority.

evidence: Budget refusal/restore tests (over-file, over-total, at-cap, 5MiB INDEX-fault) + scans/index/rows/reclamation tests green: /tmp/mik-run3/L111/a06_fast.txt (65 passed, 78 subtests, exit 0); round-8 verdict notes/reports/reviewer/4889df77-3c01-4cc7-a6ae-344b459490bd/round-8/verdict.md

statement: Copy admission, scans, index and status work stay inside explicit byte, row and entry budgets that refuse loudly instead of shedding silently.
